name: dsh-write-guard
description: Per-task write-manifest guard plugin for dsh (private, not published; check-in is the artifact, no build step). Its bare peer imports @deepseek-ai/dsh-fs (runtime FsError) and @deepseek-ai/cordis (type semantics only) are provided by the host dsh install closure through a node_modules symlink materialized by the daemon at spawn time.
